trait_ArvakSCP096_Witness_info: Marked as a witness and queued as a victim. WorldFall players can be triggered by looking at SCP-096; nearby NPCs use proximity.
trait_ArvakSCP096_RageSpeed_info: Temporary speed bonus while SCP-096 pursues its marked victims.
AllowProximityWhilePossessing: Allow proximity to trigger the controlled actor
SoundEnabled Description: Allow global warning and local proximity sounds.
FaceFlashEnabled Description: Brief translucent witness image with fade-in and fade-out.
AllowProximityWhilePossessing Descriptio: Normally WorldFall players must look at the face, not merely stand nearby.
ProximityWitnesses Description: Lightweight nearby NPC approximation for WorldBox 2D.
DeathFlashDuration Description: Duration of the image after the SCP kills the controlled actor.
DeathFlashEnabled Description: Only on kills performed by the SCP-096, not on ordinary deaths.
MusicOverrideEnabled: Mute game soundtracks during every SCP-096 hunt
MusicOverrideEnabled Description: When any witness triggers SCP-096, mute WorldBox and WorldFall background music throughout TRIGGERED and RAGE, regardless of player possession. Keep ambience, SFX and SCP custom sounds.
MusicFadeDownSeconds Description: Only the game music is lowered.
MusicFadeUpSeconds Description: Original music volume is restored after the chase.
MusicDuckingPercent Description: 100% removes BGM without muting environmental sounds.
DocileRegenPerSecond: Health points per second in DOCILE
RageRegenPerSecond: Health points per second in TRIGGERED and RAGE
RageRampSeconds: Seconds to top speed for each pursuit
RegenerationEnabled Description: Gradual recovery. The SCP can still be killed by overwhelming damage.
DocileRegenPerSecond Description: Health points restored per second outside pursuit.
RageRegenPerSecond Description: Health points restored per second while triggered or raging.
RageRampSeconds Description: Per-target capped four-stage acceleration. No stacking across victims.
trait_ArvakSCP096_RageSpeed2_info: A temporary, mutually exclusive speed stage during pursuit.
trait_ArvakSCP096_RageSpeed3_info: A temporary, mutually exclusive speed stage during pursuit.
trait_ArvakSCP096_RageSpeed4_info: A temporary, mutually exclusive speed stage during pursuit.
DreadVisionEnabled: Ominous WorldFall POV for current victim
DreadVisionEnabled Description: Darkens the 3D renderer when the possessed character is the current SCP-096 target; never affects map mode.
DreadVisionStrength Description: Adjusts vignette and shadows in the native 3D renderer; lower it for less darkness.
WorldfallReticleMode Description: Triggers SCP after holding your crosshair on it for 1.5 seconds, regardless of face orientation.
WorldfallReticleHoldSeconds Description: How long you must keep the crosshair continuously on SCP-096.
WorldfallProximityEnabled Description: Triggers SCP when the controlled character comes too close, without aiming.
WorldfallProximityTiles Description: Distance threshold for player proximity triggering SCP-096.
